disclaimer: Every before-line appears in its specified already-public source. The assistant that wrote the lyrics proposed the revision. No independent acceptability or performability review.

cards.before: No glorious entrance. Just real progress making.
cards.after: No grand arrival. Just another road I've taken.
cards.mechanism: Replace forced 'progress making' phrasing with an idiomatic, understated journey close.
cards.sourceDefect: The final clause is unidiomatic; repair the ending without sacrificing the return-to-journey payoff.

cards.before: "Occasional compassion" in a very official voice.
cards.after: Its first report read: 'Water where the roots have dried.'
cards.mechanism: Let the story's seedling need generate the ending instead of stating an abstract moral.
cards.sourceDefect: The late moral is spelled out in a bureaucratic slogan; make the seedling's need and rain create the payoff.

cards.before: A small and ordinary thing I finally understood to plan.
cards.after: Then watched the letter vanish in the postman's moving hands.
cards.mechanism: Show completion of the decision without the awkward 'understood to plan' clause.
cards.sourceDefect: Awkward phrasing weakens the action; choose a natural idiom, preserving the postcard decision.

cards.before: BOTH: It's finished when two different ways of living act as one.
cards.after: And boats pass under safely as the first commuters run.
cards.mechanism: Replace the general maxim with the newly possible shared outcome; preserve the done/run family.
cards.sourceDefect: The ending narrates its lesson rather than ending on the newly modified crossing.

cards.before: Some things stay home in the things that you hold.
cards.after: There's home in the ordinary things that we hold.
cards.mechanism: Make the refrain's idea speakable rather than 'things stay home in things' abstraction.
cards.sourceDefect: The repeated abstract line is less natural than the luggage motif; streamline to improve singability.

cards.before: The hammer hit the table, the fiddle held the note,
cards.after: Hammer taps the tabletop; the fiddle holds the note.
cards.mechanism: Add a short repeating percussion sound inside a sentence that still means something.
cards.sourceDefect: Resolution through restored imperfection is earned, but rhyme density stays simple; revise selected internals.

cards.before: And every road looked different with a meaning that it lacked.
cards.after: The river changed its course; I'd learned to redraw the track.
cards.mechanism: Tie the changed map to an observable response instead of undefined 'meaning it lacked'.
cards.sourceDefect: The closing abstract phrase is semantically unclear and consumes a rhyme slot.

cards.before: They charged a button or a joke, or sometimes nothing spent.
cards.after: They took a coin, a joke, or nothing if you couldn't pay.
cards.mechanism: Repair unidiomatic shop-payment wording without changing the community-repair scene.
cards.sourceDefect: The payment line is unidiomatic and the chorus doesn't evolve until the very end.

cards.before: Stay, little signal, don't promise what you can't,
cards.after: Stay, little signal, across the fading blue,
cards.mechanism: Build a complete singable phrase and set up a new rhyme that will require reworking the next hook line.
cards.sourceDefect: An unfinished-sounding lyrical sentence creates ambiguity; make the refrain melodically self-contained.
cards.adjacentWorkNeeded: Next line needs separate revision for blue/through cadence before production use.

cards.before: ELI: And the little gear is seen.
cards.after: ELI: The ticking finally sounds clean.
cards.mechanism: Make the answering apprentice report an audible result rather than the vague gear 'being seen'.
cards.sourceDefect: The verbal payoff is mechanically flat; finish the successful repair with sound/action rather than a generic observation.

cards.before: And let the bird rest by the parts of its section.
cards.after: And set the brass bird among our finished inventions.
cards.mechanism: Replace opaque 'parts of its section' with an observable action and a natural near-rhyme.
cards.sourceDefect: The final rhyme is semantically forced; internal rhymes often name machinery without moving the plot.

cards.before: Standing by the elevator with a girl who would be later.
cards.after: Standing by the lift with a child in a red coat.
cards.mechanism: Clarify the photograph rather than forcing a rhyme that makes the reveal unintelligible.
cards.sourceDefect: The central reveal is obscured by strained time/rhyme syntax; rewrite the relationship as a legible event.
cards.adjacentWorkNeeded: Neighboring lines 15 and 17 need revision because they repeat 'coat' or lose end rhyme.

cards.song: The Arguments of Day and Night
cards.before: BOTH: It's how we pass the morning when the evening passes by.
cards.after: BOTH: We'll take turns keeping watch till the bakers pass us by.
cards.mechanism: Replace an abstract moral with a negotiated, daily-world conclusion.
cards.sourceDefect: The final idea is agreeable but predictable; the voices could negotiate a tangible shared responsibility.

cards.before: The ghost sent out a costume that revealed what characters mean.
cards.after: The ghost made silver boots for the queen to cross the scene.
cards.mechanism: Replace an abstract 'revealed what characters mean' comment with a scene-level prop and character action.
cards.sourceDefect: A line explains rather than dramatizes the magic; some consonant-heavy couplets don't fit the swing label naturally.
